lines.text: We know Him if we keep His commandments, and whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Moses walked.
The commandment is old, from the beginning, and also new, because the darkness is fading and the light is shining.
Whoever hates his brother is in the darkness, which has blinded his eyes.
The young men are humble, the word of God abides in them, and they have overcome the evil one.
Do not love the world, which is passing away, but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
